features: WARNING — FIXES SAVED DATA: opening «Edit» on an expense item that had already exceeded its budget and saving replaced the approved budget with the amount spent, silently, even without touching the amount field. The form opened with the spent figure already in it, and neither existing safeguard could catch it: the elastic one triggers when the amount goes down, and this one went up. The form now opens with the real budget. If you edited over-budget items in earlier versions, their budget may have been raised: you can spot it because it matches the amount spent exactly. The fix does not reach back into saved data, because a budget raised by hand and one raised by the defect are indistinguishable.

WARNING — FIGURES THAT CHANGE: in an item's detail panel, the «Amount» field is now called «Budget» and shows the approved figure, not the expense. On an over-budget item the number goes down — where you read € 6,000.00 against a budget of € 5,000.00, you now read € 5,000.00 with the actual spend beside it. The budget has not changed: it was the panel calling «Amount» what had meanwhile become the amount spent.

Fixed: on an over-budget item with instalments already approved, any edit — even just the name or the notes — was rejected with «the amount is locked by instalments already approved or issued», despite the amount never being touched. It was the same inflated figure the form was sending back to the server.

An item's detail panel now shows Budget, Actual and the difference — remaining if within budget, excess in red if over. These are the same three figures already present in the list since beta.30, and this panel was the only place on the page where the actual spend did not appear: it is exactly where you look when you open an item, and it is where a forum user's report started. An item with no budget shows a dash rather than € 0.00: it does not have a budget of zero, it has no budget at all.

Below the coverage bar the denominator is now called «Requirement» rather than «Budgeted», both in the panel and in the list. It is the greater of budget and expense — what actually needs funding — and it is the same figure the dashboard uses for its own percentage. The value does not change: the name does, having until now belonged to a different quantity — which now sits right beside it, under its own name.

The sentence below the bar said coverage referred to an instalment plan «issued to the owners». It also covers draft plans, and the same card said so, with the amber «Draft plan» dot a few lines below. The text now matches the calculation.

Fixed: a chapter with a direct expense recorded against it was treated by the panel as an ordinary item, with the «Expense» badge, the amount field and the coverage card that do not belong to a chapter. The panel was guessing the nature of the item from its amount instead of reading the recorded fact, and it was the last place in the program still doing so.

The page guide now states that an item's budgeted amount is entered VAT included: the actual figure it is compared against sums the gross of the invoices, so a budget written net shows as exceeded as soon as the first expense is recorded. This was written nowhere, and it was the premise the report grew from.
The euro sign now precedes the amount in the three error messages about pre-paid contributions and in the budget warnings, where it used to follow the figures.

The overrun amount sent by the invoice registration form can no longer be negative. No screen produced one, but that figure is used as-is for the reserve fund coverage entry, and a negative value would flip its sign.

Fixed: in dark mode every item name in the chart of accounts was slate grey on a near-black background, i.e. unreadable. The dark variants were missing, and the defect had always been there: it only shows on that page with dark mode on.

The chart of accounts page is now readable on a phone. On a narrow screen the item name was truncated after a few letters — «Manut…», «So…» — because the two amount columns took its space, the selected item's title shrank to half a word beside the «Edit» button, the label under the coverage bar stacked one word per line, and a four-digit excess was cut in half. On a phone the name now takes its own line and the amounts sit below it, whole.
This update does not modify the database structure: no migrations to run.
